title: 第230章  血蛊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

与此同时，天峰山南麓守山台。

顾沉舟站在祭坛前。

顾怀山遗骨木盒与母发玉瓶安置在安骨位中，旧阵微微亮着暗红光芒。

山风吹过石台，带起低低回响。

顾沉舟今日重新戴上了青铜面具。

不是为了遮脸。

而是为了压心。

面具冰冷，贴在脸上，能提醒他今日不是复仇日。

至少在黑先生现身前，不是。

他身旁有霍家两名武者和顾家残阵符石。

再远处，秦老亲自带人守住通往死门的山路。

顾沉舟手中握着摄魂铃。

铃身安静。

但从清晨开始，死门方向已经传来三次极轻的回响。

像井下的东西在试探三门。

顾沉舟闭目感应。

死门未裂。

但气机正在变薄。

这不是真正破封，而是井心那东西借茶会人气、金石阵眼和魂灯气息一点点顶住死门。

守山台旧阵亮起一圈微光。

顾怀山遗骨木盒安静无声。

母发玉瓶也没有异动。

顾沉舟心中稍安。

至少黑先生没有再从父母遗物这条线先动手。

但他不会因此放松。

因为越是没有动静，越说明对方在等更关键的时机。

忽然，摄魂铃轻轻响了一声。

顾沉舟睁开眼，看向天峰山庄方向。

“开始了。”

上午九点。

天峰茶会正式开始。

没有致辞太久。

没有寒暄铺垫。

江怀远只以简短几句说明茶会改制，随后便退到会场边缘。

霍景渊代表霍家宣布今日交流以武道切磋为主，不涉及世俗商业议题。

这让少数不知内情的武者有些意外。

但他们很快发现，在场气氛压抑得根本不像普通茶会。

尤其是金石门的人。

陆沉站在那里，像一把出鞘前的刀。

宋青山也走上擂台。

会场瞬间安静。

所有人的目光都落在两人身上。

金石门执法堂陆沉。

杏林阁宋青山。

两人前几日已在天峰山后山交过手。

陆沉败。

但今日，他们再次站上擂台。

这意味着什么，没人完全清楚。

只有知道局中局的人明白，这不是单纯比武。

这是第一道明面气机的引动。

陆沉缓缓拔刀。

短刀出鞘，寒光映着阴天。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At the same time, the southern foot of Tianfeng Mountain was guarding the mountain platform.

Gu Chenzhou stood in front of the altar.

The wooden box of Gu Huaishan's remains and the jade bottle of mother's hair were placed in the bone resting place, and the old formation glowed faintly with a dark red light.

The mountain wind blew through the stone platform, causing a low echo.

Gu Chenzhou put on the bronze mask again today.

Not to cover your face.

But to put pressure on one's heart.

The mask was cold and stuck to his face, reminding him that today was not a day of revenge.

At least not until Mr. Black showed up.

Beside him were two warriors from the Huo family and the remaining formation rune stones from the Gu family.

Farther away, Mr. Qin personally led people to guard the mountain road leading to the door of death.

Gu Chenzhou held the Soul Seizing Bell in his hand.

The bell is quiet.

But since early morning, there have been three very light echoes from the direction of Death's Door.

Like something underground testing the three gates.

Gu Chenzhou closed his eyes and sensed.

The door of death is not broken.

But the qi machine is getting thinner.

This is not really breaking the seal, but the thing in the center of the well is using the popularity of the tea party, the golden stone formation eyes and the breath of the soul lamp to hold back the door of death little by little.

The old formation of Shoushantai lit up with a faint light.

The wooden box of Gu Huaishan's remains was silent.

There was no abnormal movement in the female hair jade bottle.

Gu Chenzhou felt a little relieved.

At least Mr. Hei didn't start with his parents' relics.

But he won't relax.

Because the less movement there is, the more it means the other party is waiting for a more critical opportunity.

Suddenly, the soul-catching bell rang softly.

Gu Chenzhou opened his eyes and looked in the direction of Tianfeng Villa.

"It's begun."

Nine o'clock in the morning.

The Tianfeng tea party officially begins.

There was no speech for too long.

There is no pleasantries to set the stage.

Jiang Huaiyuan only explained the restructuring of the tea party in a few words, and then retreated to the edge of the venue.

On behalf of the Huo family, Huo Jingyuan announced that today's exchange will focus on martial arts discussions and will not involve secular business issues.

This surprised the few warriors who didn't know the inside story.

But they soon discovered that the atmosphere was nothing like an ordinary tea party.

Especially the people from Jinshimen.

Lu Chen stood there like a knife before it was unsheathed.

Song Qingshan also stepped onto the ring.

The venue fell silent for a moment.

Everyone's eyes fell on the two of them.

Jinshimen Law Enforcement Hall Lu Chen.

Xinglin Pavilion Song Qingshan.

The two had fought against each other in the back mountain of Tianfeng Mountain a few days ago.

Lu Chen was defeated.

But today, they stood in the ring again.

What this means, no one quite knows.

Only those who know the game within the game understand that this is not a simple competition.

This is the first clear inspiration of Qi.

Lu Chen slowly drew his sword.

The short sword was unsheathed, and the cold light reflected the cloudy sky.
